page.heading: Supplier Subscriptions

empty.title: No supplier subscriptions found

form.name: Subscription Name
form.startTimeInfo: Optional time of day in the operator's display timezone. Leave blank for start of day (00:00).
form.endTimeInfo: Optional time of day in the operator's display timezone. Leave blank for end of day (23:59).
form.autoRenewHint: When enabled, an operator can extend this subscription at term end. No automatic renewal — the operator clicks Renew to extend the end date.
form.supplierInfo: The supplier this subscription is with.
form.costPlanInfo: The cost plan governing this subscription. Determines billing amount, cycle, and billing currency.
form.codeInfo: Short reference for this subscription. Leave blank to auto-generate.
form.startDateInfo: First day this subscription is active. Billing cycles are counted from this date.
form.endDateInfo: Last day this subscription is active. Leave blank for open-ended.
form.startDateRowHelp: Start date affects which cost plans are available — only cost plans active in this date range can be selected.
form.endDateRowHelp: End date controls when recurring expenditures stop being generated. Leave blank for open-ended billing.
form.notesInfo: Internal remarks — shown on detail pages but not on supplier-facing documents.
